title: docs(qa): 57 platform-checklist rows from the #23104 browser pass re-pointed to the product at the pin (#23169)
body:
Part of #23169
Clause-②: no

The browser pass of #23104 recorded two runs: QA run #23163 (`surface:browser`) and QA run #23166 (`surface:mixed`). Both ran at objectstack `36b2889c` with objectui `1fb1ced36243`. After #23121 closed, they parked 59 checklist rows on it, and two more rows were appended to it after its claim. #23169 carries all 61.

This PR lands 57 of the 61 rows. It revises 51 items across 15 area files, two area recipes and one RUNNER.md environment fact. Each revised item gets `revision` +1 and one appended `history` entry. The entry names the row, its run and the fields it touched. No product code, test or fixture changes.

**#23169 stays open after this PR:**

- `access-security.share-link-landing-page` C3 waits for PR #23222, which edits `access-security.json`.
- `platform-core.lifecycle-retention-sweep` steps[4] waits on a maintainer ruling (below).

**How each row was checked.** `.objectui-sha` on `main` is still `1fb1ced36243`, the console both runs drove.

- Console rows: re-read from objectui source at that pin.
- Framework rows: re-read from this repo's source at the base, `6d7f4df3c`.
- No browser was driven and no app was booted. Where only a live run can show the behaviour, the row rests on the run record's evidence, and its history entry names the run.
- Clause and step indices below are zero-based, like a run record's. The run's own lane label (`A0`, `C2`, …) is in brackets.

## Where this differs from the card's suggested edit

1. **`records-forms.record-edit-undo`** gets a `blocked: { by: 'fixture', ref: … }` annotation, so the item "stays BLOCKED" as the card says.
   - No card tracks the packaged-undoable fixture, so `ref` names the gap in words.
   - Consequence: `scripts/checklist-select.mjs` hides the item from default runs, and `--include-blocked` lists it.
2. **`dashboards.system-overview-live-counts` A3.** The card says `system_overview` has "no `widget_organizations`".
   - The source declares 9 widgets, and `widget_organizations` is one of them.
   - The server strips it on an unmet `requiresService`, so the served body carries 8. The run read the served body.
   - The item now names both layers.
3. **`integration-system.notify-inbox-delivery` A3-501.** The card lists it as "(in knownGaps)", but the item had no such knownGap. One was added.
4. **`platform-core.lifecycle-retention-sweep` C1.** Only the step-3 half is applied. steps[4] (idle sweep) is left with a "ruling owed" knownGap and is not rewritten.
5. **Coupled fields.** Where other fields of the same item restate the same stale fact, they are revised too, and each one is named in the item's history entry. This is the same practice as #23132.
   - email-template-render: title, steps[3], acceptance[0] / [2], source[2].
   - draft-publish-lifecycle: steps[8], acceptance[7].
   - keyboard-shortcut-surface: title, knownGaps, sources.
   - setup-packaged-automation-board: one more note. acceptance[5]'s member cell cannot be reached through the page while the measured posture holds.
6. **write-feedback, disabled-control-reason and labels-over-machine-names.** Besides retiring the fixed knownGaps, the edits name the run's new cards (objectui#12303, #23157), so the next run cites them rather than re-filing.
7. **Recipe edits** (`search:qa-contributor-bound-member` step 5, `attachments-storage:qa-scratch-authz` step 6). Recipes carry no revision, so only the item each row names is bumped.
   - Other consumers whose clauses did not change are not bumped: `search.rls-both-personas`, `search.global-search-skips-unreadable`, `records-forms.crud-roundtrip`, and the other two `qa-scratch-authz` users.
   - Each recipe's `provenance` names the correction.

| `approvals.decision-action-matrix` A9-wire (fixture gap, in knownGaps) | knownGaps[0] already records it in full |
| `studio-authoring.metadata-diagnostics-sweep` A6 (fixture gap, in knownGaps) | knownGaps[0] already records it in full. The item's A1 row is landed above |
| `integration-system.webhook-lifecycle` N1 / N2 | the run did not attempt them, and the item's text for them is right. The new knownGaps[1] says a re-run owes them |
| `access-security.share-link-landing-page` C3 | **deferred**: it waits for PR #23222 |

## Maintainer ruling owed

**`platform-core.lifecycle-retention-sweep` steps[4]: should an idle sweep log nothing?** It logs `18 policy(ies) applied, ~0 rows reaped` today.

- The print gate tests `report.swept.length`. Every applied policy pushes an entry, `deleted: 0` included, and `LifecycleSweepReport.swept`'s docblock says "one entry per (object, policy)".
- That reads like "one aggregate line per sweep" (ADR-0057 §3.3) working as designed. If so, the step is stale.
- The step's reading, that the line prints only when rows moved, is also plausible. If so, it is a product defect.
- The item now says how a run scores the step until this is ruled, and no acceptance clause rests on it.

- **Anchor census:** symbol anchors only rose (`--anchor-census` base vs head: 716 → 725 resolved). Per file: api-backend 66 → 67, dashboards 22 → 24, identity-auth 90 → 91, platform-core 67 → 69, records-forms 94 → 96, studio-authoring 36 → 37. No file fell.
- **Edits were scripted and span-checked:** every edit asserts its anchor occurs exactly once inside its item. The script also checked that every untouched item parses identical to base, and that each touched item gained exactly +1 revision and one history entry.
- **`skip-changeset`:** `docs/qa/**` ships in no package, and no `package.json` names it.

## Acceptance notes

These are noted, not filed: each is a source read without a reproduction, or an observation.

- **The 8 red `check:platform-checklist` problems predate this PR.** They are in `access-security.public-form-withdrawal-layers`, `attachments-storage.attach-requires-parent-edit` and `search.rls-both-personas`. The daily platform-checklist watchdog reports them; #23139 closed them `not_planned`.
- **The console's boot splash reads `vite-ui-theme`, while the shell stores `object-ui-theme`.** At objectui `1fb1ced36243`, `apps/console/index.html` reads the first key and `ConsoleShell.tsx` stores the second. From source, a user who picked Dark on a light-OS machine may get a light first frame. Not reproduced.
- **`sys-metadata-activation.object.ts` says "Reads stay open"**, but QA run #23163 measured a member's activation read answering 403. That item's maintainer question covers it.
- **Runtime-authored actions are not joined into the served object's `actions[]`.** QA run #23163 measured this and recorded it as a fixture gap, and this PR records it the same way. Whether runtime action authoring should reach the served object is not judged here.
- **The shipped `showcase_task_changed` webhook shows `active:true` in Setup but can never fan out on the org-walled showcase**, because it materializes org-less. The run's maintainer question on in-org bulk events is the nearest open thread.
- **The run records name a few Studio routes by observation only:** the Data pillar records grid and the metadata designer's Discard draft. The edits cite them as the runs saw them.
